Rochester publishes the assessment data Ontario denies.
The UK reference atlas's method rests on VOA rating-list values; MPAC withholds the Ontario equivalent. Rochester's
4,717 parcels currently carry zero of it

— an observation from a register, not an inference from absence. That is a categorically stronger evidence class than anything the Niagara method can produce, and twelve snapshots make it a trajectory rather than a snapshot.
Waterloo repeats the Niagara structural pattern
— one shared catalogue, an upper tier plus lower-tier municipalities, separate address layers per municipality on separate hosts. Its ceiling is the

under-occupancy cannot be one computation. In Ontario it is a ratio of floor area and employment against parcel area, computed from the employment upper bound. In Rochester it is improvement value over total value from an assessment register. Same question, different method, different evidence class — and the class has to travel with the score rather than being averaged away.
Not probed, recorded so the gap is explicit:
Region of Waterloo's own 125 datasets; Monroe County (portal does not resolve); licence terms for either region; Buffalo. And critically,
is genuinely stable across all twelve Rochester snapshots is assumed, not verified
— it is the single most load-bearing assumption here and needs the same test
(413 lines, 14 sections). Design conversation ran through a long discovery phase; every correction below was checked against real data before being written in.
Access attributes corrected — six of the engine spec's original access attributes measured the wrong geometry:

dist_rail_m       -> dist_rail_served_m      (spur/siding/yard/industrial; exclude crossover, mainline)
dist_regional_road_m -> dist_truck_route_m   (+ RESTRICTED, TIME_OF_DAY)
dist_highway_m    -> dist_interchange_m      (265 motorway junctions observed)
dist_border_m     -> dist_commercial_crossing_m (Rainbow Bridge is passenger-only)
dist_canal_m      -> dist_water_loading_m    (~18 real points; canal is transit not loading)
dist_airport_m    -> dist_cargo_airport_m    (Hamilton J.C. Munro is cargo; Niagara District is not)
transit_400m      -> transit_service_at_shift_times (GTFS)
Servicing recovered as capacity rather than membership: Hamilton sewer main 54,115 features carry PIPEDIAM/PIPEHT/INSTDATE; watermain 38,298 carry WAT_SIZE/PRESZONE/INSTDATE.

Two constraint reclassifications: archaeological potential is a screening trigger not a prohibition; heritage designated and listed are different legal states. New veto class for conditions that disqualify rather than subtract — low clearance (229 maxheight features), attenuation zones (subsurface), landlocked parcels, non-commercial crossings.

Seven provincial regulatory registers added as a source class: HWIN (annual 2002-), EWRB, Permit to Take Water, Spills (2003-2022), Aggregate Sites, Waste Management Sites, Attenuation Zones. All OGL Ontario, all address-keyed, all consumed through the J2 join built in plan 1.
Agri-industrial: 612 greenhouses, 836 vineyards, 176 orchards, 82 wineries observed in the study area.

The design's substance is corrections, not additions. Every one of the six access attributes computed cleanly and answered a question nobody asked — the same failure that produced 64 false departures in plan 1, and the reason the discovery phase ran as long as it did.

Two findings changed what the engine can claim rather than merely how it computes. HWIN beats the NEI on regulatory standing, time depth and scale measurement. EWRB closes a gap the engine spec had recorded as structural: it observes occupancy through energy consumption where MPAC denies it through assessment. The general lesson, written into the design as §8: regulation leaves better evidence than planning does, and none of these registers appears in any municipal catalogue.

Requested: a technical report bringing the sidebar dossier to life for a reviewer who is a data scientist and mathematician, building up across sections to how formulas, assertions and ratings are created and substantiated, with an optional mathematical appendix.
— 658 lines. Ten body sections, three appendices (A formulas, B worked evaluation, C open questions).

Defect 1 — fabricated precision (found and corrected pre-commit)
I wrote that computed areas agree with Welland's published
to a "median relative error of 3.6×10⁻⁷ across 1,980 polygons."
What was actually measured on 2026-08-23 and recorded at
| shapely area vs Welland `GeometrySTArea`, 1,980 polygons | median 0.0000%, p95 0.0000% |

The polygon count was right; the error figure was invented. 3.6×10⁻⁷ is consistent with a reading that rounds to 0.0000%, which is exactly what makes it dangerous — it is not detectably wrong, it is merely unsourced. Anyone recomputing it would get a different number in that range and have no way to know which of us had measured.

This is precisely the failure mode §7 of the document warns against, committed in the document itself, in the appendix that argues for measurement over assumption. Logged in full rather than quietly patched.
, with the added sentence that this is agreement to the reported precision of the check — the strongest statement the measurement supports and no stronger.
Defect 2 — three jurisdictions collapsed into one (found and corrected pre-commit)
The dormancy table was headed "Measured 2026-08-23 across the study area" over all six rows. The source table at
carries a Coverage column with three distinct values:
the NEI is a Niagara Region product and does not cover Hamilton)
Presenting all six under one heading implies they are commensurable and invites a reader to sum or compare them. It also violates the binding rule in
: "Niagara Region" is an upper-tier municipality and a data publisher, never a synonym for the area.

Coverage column restored with all three values, plus an explicit sentence that the three families cannot be summed, plus the denominator (121 departures from 12,016 businesses) which the original table omitted and without which 121 is uninterpretable.
Worked subject is Hopkins Steel Works, 2 Broadway, Welland — chosen because
assembling its dossier is what falsified the departures layer on 2026-08-23 (64 of 68 claims false). §6 therefore treats refutation as a pipeline stage, not a display concern.
Appendix B's worked evaluation deliberately terminates in

publishes no parcel fabric, so every area-denominated input is null. The correct output of the flagship worked example is "unavailable." This is the strongest available statement of the silent-zero rule.
3,400 m², and the decay parameters λ=0.6, μ=0.05. Everything else is
. λ and μ are unfitted and Appendix C.4 says so.
Appendix C lists six design choices as open questions rather than settled

results: additive independence (known false), multiplicative confidence compounding, the one-sided E_h conservatism convention, the unfitted decay parameters, whether confidence should itself be an interval, and the flat 5 km ceiling.
No new computation was run. This document reports existing measurements; it
still carries the runaway agent's fabricated figures and
still needs its append-only correction entry. Unchanged by this work.
